[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-oc[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Excellent shell completion for the sase CLI[/bold #D7AFFF]

[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]argparse tree.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]8[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202608/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]cli_completion.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Completion spec model and argparse walker[/bold #D7AFFF]                     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]spec[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]spec: build the sase-owned CompletionSpec model, the argparse tree [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]walker that produces it, help shortening, alias/hidden policy, the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]value-kind resolver, and the checked-in structural snapshot that makes [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]grammar drift a reviewable diff.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Zsh emitter and the sase completion command group[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]zsh[dim] · [dim][/dim]after spec[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]zsh: emit a native `_arguments` compsys script from the spec with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]descriptions, exclusion lists, mutex groups, `-S`, and remainders, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]register the `sase completion` command group with its `list`, `spec`, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and `zsh` children.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bash and fish emitters[/bold #D7AFFF]                                        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]shells[dim] · [dim][/dim]after zsh[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]shells: add bash and fish emitters over the same spec plus their `sase [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]completion bash` and `sase completion fish` children, so every supported[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]shell shares one grammar, one alias policy, and one description pass.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Pre-argparse candidates fast path[/bold #D7AFFF]                             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]candidates[dim] · [dim][/dim]after zsh[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]candidates: add the `sase completion candidates` fast path ahead of [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]argparse in entry.py, its value/description wire format, its disk cache,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the project and bead providers, and the import-set and latency contract [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tests that keep it fast.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Value-kind provider catalog[/bold #D7AFFF]                                   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]kinds[dim] · [dim][/dim]after candidates[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]kinds: fill out the remaining value-kind providers behind the existing [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]seam, routing each through sase_core_rs or an equally cheap catalog and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rendering project display names rather than ProjectSpec keys.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Dynamic values wired into every shell[/bold #D7AFFF]                         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]wire[dim] · [dim][/dim]after shells, kinds[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]wire: teach all three emitters to call the candidates fast path for [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]kinded slots, with a hand-written zsh preamble that groups and tags [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]results and caches them in-shell, plus the bash and fish equivalents.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Install, verification, doctor, and refresh[/bold #D7AFFF]                    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]install[dim] · [dim][/dim]after shells[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]install: add `sase completion install` that picks a directory compinit [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]actually scans, zcompiles, verifies registration, and stamps the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]install, plus the doctor check and the flagged `sase update` refresh [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]hook.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Documentation, polish, and reach[/bold #D7AFFF]                              [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]docs[dim] · [dim][/dim]after wire, install[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]docs: document the feature end to end, ship the recommended zstyle [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]snippet, close the remaining polish items, and record what was [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]deliberately deferred.[/#D7D7AF]
